label: Care
rationale: moral intuition about harm/kindness; usually carried by stance, not stated

label: Equality
rationale: intuition about egalitarian treatment; inferred from the argument's framing

label: Proportionality
rationale: intuition about reward matching merit; inferred from framing

label: Loyalty
rationale: in-group/out-group intuition; inferred from framing

label: Authority
rationale: deference to legitimate authority/tradition; inferred from framing

label: Purity
rationale: sanctity/degradation intuition; inferred, often metaphorical

label: Thin Morality
rationale: a moral judgment present but not in the six domains; needs both inferences

label: Non-Moral
rationale: absence of moral sentiment; requires ruling out all implied sentiment

label: Change talk
rationale: direction relative to the change goal; reasons/steps often implicit, agreement inherits the prior turn

label: Sustain talk
rationale: direction toward the status quo; same inference as change talk

label: Neutral talk
rationale: no inclination either way; ruling out implied direction

label: Reflection
rationale: returns content of the client's last statement; must compare with previous turn

label: Question
rationale: grammatical/interrogative form

label: Therapist input
rationale: information/advice/options stated explicitly

label: Other
rationale: none of the three; mostly backchannels and closings

label: Keeping Everyone Together
rationale: turn-taking, attention, yes/no questions not about another student's idea

label: Getting Students to Relate
rationale: prompt to engage with another student's contribution

label: Restating
rationale: word-for-word repetition of a student; a string match against the previous turn

label: Pressing for Accuracy
rationale: prompt for an answer, procedure, or term

label: Revoicing
rationale: repeats a student with changes; compare with previous turn

label: Pressing for Reasoning
rationale: prompt to explain/justify; distinguished from accuracy by phrasing
not a talk move; explicit 'not coded' list

label: Relating to Another Student
rationale: builds on/answers/agrees with another student

label: Asking for More Information
rationale: asks for information or states confusion

label: Making a Claim
rationale: states an answer or math fact without reasoning

label: Providing Evidence or Reasoning
rationale: reasoning markers: multi-step procedure, because, if/then, pattern
none of the four moves

label: Scholar
rationale: described as scholar/intellectual; explicit wording with tie-break rules

label: Activist
rationale: called activist/leader or activism noted; allows 'clearly implied'

label: Monumental Memorialization
rationale: an object named after Du Bois; lexical

label: Mention of Scholarly Work
rationale: his academic works or concepts mentioned or quoted

label: Social/Political Advocacy
rationale: 'mentions or implies' activism, critique, or engagement with Black identity

label: Coalition Building
rationale: reputation built through organizational sponsorship; abstract, one sentence

label: Out of the Mouth of Academics
rationale: a member of an academic organization engages with Du Bois; speaker role must be identified

label: Out of the Mouth of Activists
rationale: activist/political speaker whose role may be 'implied through actions or affiliations'

label: Collective Synecdoche
rationale: listed with others 'in order to represent' a culture or era; intent of the listing
